shelfDecks.note: Source Z-up deck heights 0.45/1.58/2.33m (measured horizontal-face clusters, full-span decks); GLB keeps meters; browser Y-scale 2000/3010.001=0.6644516 maps to canonical rack height.

slotVolumeNote: Each location slot volume = usable WxD centered on its width-row anchor, Y from deck-0 scaled height (299.003mm) up usable height (1000mm) to 1299.003mm. All container AABBs must fit all three axes; tops must also clear the next deck above their base deck.

verification.note: boundEps covers float32 buffer noise only (0.01mm); contactTolerance allows face-to-face stacking contact (declared, not hidden interpenetration). No downward rounding is used as fit authority.
